description: This file implements client-side prediction and collision detection logic for a game, including functions for building solid entity lists, tracing movement, interpolating player states, and predicting player movement based on user commands and server snapshots.

methods.name: CG_BuildSolidList
methods.description: Builds a list of solid entities for collision detection based on the current snapshot.

methods.name: CG_ClipMoveToEntities
methods.description: Performs collision checks against entities in the solid list during movement.

methods.name: CG_Trace
methods.description: Performs a trace (collision detection) from start to end, considering entities.

methods.name: CG_CapTrace
methods.description: Performs a capsule trace from start to end, considering entities.

methods.name: CG_PointContents
methods.description: Determines the contents (e.g., solid, water) at a point, considering entities.

methods.name: CG_InterpolatePlayerState
methods.description: Interpolates between snapshots to generate the predicted player state.

methods.name: CG_TouchTriggerPrediction
methods.description: Predicts interactions with triggers and items based on current position.

methods.name: CG_IsUnacceptableError
methods.description: Checks if the difference between predicted and actual player states exceeds acceptable thresholds.

methods.name: CG_PredictPlayerState
methods.description: Predicts the player's movement and state for the current frame based on user commands and server snapshots.
